verdict.rationale: Datalab documents a Document Segmentation capability that splits multi-document PDFs into separate logical sections. Its /segment endpoint takes a schema, which acts as the classification step, and returns page ranges for each identified segment. Pipelines can chain convert, extract and segment, and checkpoints let /segment and /extract reuse a single parse, so one upload can feed downstream processing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that each segment automatically gets its own per-document extraction output (only page ranges are evidenced), detail on how classification labels are assigned, and independent or hands-on corroboration of segmentation quality.
